errata.locus: Seat 40/01, classical-philology-1906-1922: its title, scope and description ('Classical Philology I–XVII … whole, item by item'; 'Every Classical Philology item the Archive holds as Early Journal Content dated 1906–1922')
errata.was: Classical Philology I–XVII (1906–1922) seated whole, 821 items, every item the Archive holds as Early Journal Content.
errata.now: The seat holds the journal's Book Reviews section, 1906–1922: 812 items from the Archive's collection jstor_clasphil, nearly all of them pages of Book Reviews, and one article (Kelsey, 'Is There a Science of Classical Philology?', 1908). Nine further items are not Classical Philology. They are pieces from the Classical Journal, the Classical Weekly and similar, whose titles name the journal, and the advanced-search listing returned them: jstor-3292089, 4385989, 3286898, 4387849, 3287348, 4388224, 3287997, 3286842, 4387350. The articles and notes, 902 items of the same collection, were not in the listing used and are not seated. They are being gathered for a later seat. The files seated, their hashes and the seat's AXN stand.
errata.reason: Found on 16 November 2026 while coding the seat on the page: the readers found 766 of 775 distinct texts to be review pages. A search of the collection jstor_clasphil (1,714 items) showed the 902 articles and notes missing from the advanced-search listing the fetch had used, which matched the journal's name and returned mainly the untitled review pages.
errata.raised_by: Claude (Anthropic) in session, 2026-11-16, under the standing rule that real errors are raised at once
errata.status: erratum issued; the seat's files unchanged; the articles to be seated
